law_equivalence_controls: OCCURRENCE_K2 is exactly FIXED_RUN1_K2 under the same state seed
MARKOV_M2_K2 has the same independent fair-state law but a different construction

execution_guard.rule: No call to scorer.one_eval and no target-derived d3/E1 computation may occur until protocol.json SHA-256 is verified by the workflow freeze job.

invariants.document_rule: canonical ReM documents with >=2000 clean tokens; use first 2000
invariants.lineation: artificial groups of 10 source tokens, identical to Phase 3 scoring harness

lag_diagnostics.direct_target_proxy_reason: The inherited frozen scorer supplies the target scalar phenotype, not an observed latent origin state. Introducing an ad-hoc Voynich phase proxy would add a new tuned statistic; any such proxy requires a separate preregistration.
lag_diagnostics.fixed_block_theory: rho(h)=max(1-h/L,0) for h>=1 after averaging block phase
lag_diagnostics.role: primary mechanistic diagnostic; empirical state law is reported independently of target score
lag_diagnostics.state_coding: 0->-1, 1->+1; Pearson autocorrelation at each token lag

primary_endpoints: representation-robust d3 improvement/retention relative to OCCURRENCE_K2; OCCURRENCE_KALL retained only as historical Phase-3 comparator
representation-robust E1 log-error improvement relative to OCCURRENCE_K2
empirical lag-correlation law versus the arm's preregistered theoretical law
scientific_question: Does the Voynich-like local-neighbour effect arise from a genuine short-memory latent origin state, and what is its correlation law?

shape_test.document_contrast: C = mean(endpoint d3) - mean(middle d3); positive means an intermediate-persistence advantage
shape_test.partial_intermediate_rule: lower 95% bootstrap CI > 0 in one family and median contrast >= 0 in the other
shape_test.strong_intermediate_rule: lower 95% bootstrap CI > 0 in both fixed and Markov families

simulation.common_random_numbers_reason: Identical outputs must score identically; paired Monte Carlo noise is held constant across arms so persistence is the only changed factor.
